hardRules.initialScrollPosition: top; no automatic scroll that moves the battlefield outside the viewport
hardRules.heightGrowth: UIを巨大化せずbattlefieldとatmospheric depthへ配分
hardRules.widthReduction: critical text、target、catをminimum未満に縮めず、補助文と装飾を先に減らす

measurement.cssViewport: window.visualViewportが利用可能なら実可視領域も観測し、layout viewportとの差をevidenceへ記録
measurement.activeViewport: block-size calculations use 100dvh where supported with 100svh fallback
measurement.keyboard: modal/inputが将来入る場合はvisualViewportでactionをkeyboard上へ保持。P1 S02 battle本体にtext inputは置かない。
measurement.browserBars: dvh変化時にbattlefieldのfoot anchorまたはbottom navがjumpしないようstable minimum + flow layoutを使う

globalMinimums.rule: viewport不足を理由にminimumを下げない。document heightを増やしてscroll continuationを許可する。

layoutOrder: safe top spacer and compact resource/floor header
contextual next useful action if separate from navigation
five-destination bottom navigation with safe bottom

heightBands.rule: width bandとheight bandを独立判定する。375x667はwide-short、320x800はcompact-standardとして扱う。

shrink: panel decoration depth and brass ornaments
party portraitをminimum card sizeまで。ただしcat visible faceを保つ
reflow: resource chipをfloor header内の一列へ統合
party state labelをportrait下の一行へ固定し、nameは必要時に省略規則を使う
bottom navigation labelsを11pxの二行以内にする
collapse: shop/delivery detailを一つのreal status rowまたはS05 navigationへ
support countdownをcanonical値がない場合は完全に消す
hide: resource not required for current combat decision
expand: document flow below battlefield; critical content may continue by vertical scroll
viewportContracts.scroll: initial viewportはfloor + battlefieldを保持。party dock以降はflowで続き、bottom navはsafe-area付sticky。focusによるbattle auto-scrollは禁止。
viewportContracts.primaryAction: direct damage actionは置かない。next navigationは48px bottom-nav character/tower destinationまたはreal contextual action。
viewportContracts.modal: bottom sheet; max-height = 100dvh - safeTop - 8px; header/action fixed, body scrollable

maintain: four distinct cats or honest field subset
reflow: four party cards in four equal columns
objective label and progress on two rows if needed
collapse: support explanation to icon + exact state label
expand: 12px vertical breathing room between battle and party compared with 320x568
viewportContracts.modal: bottom sheet by default; actions full width and at least48px

maintain: enemy exact HP text when it fits
shrink: vertical gaps before text or targets
reflow: objective and AUTO share row only when each target retains44px
collapse: long shop effect description to one-line battle impact
hide: ambient particles if they compete with attack effects
expand: battle width and attack-path separation, not UI scale
viewportContracts.modal: center sheet if content fits; otherwise bottom sheet with scroll body

shrink: gutter 16px retained; only decorative cap size may shrink
reflow: resource chips may share header row
collapse: secondary support explanation if it causes initial overflow
expand: battlefield above 352px before any UI grows
viewportContracts.modal: center sheet up to calc(100dvh - safe areas - 32px)

shrink: none from reference; token sizes are canonical
reflow: GM07 modal overlays but battlefield remains identifiable beneath scrim
collapse: only P2 copy when large text is active
hide: P3 store, gacha, event and monetization detail
expand: battlefield and atmosphere before top or bottom chrome
viewportContracts.modal: center sheet maximum width358px; safe-area bounded; footer action48px

maintain: cat preferred size without boss-like enemy scale
reflow: support summary may show effect plus next arrival on two balanced lines
hide: P3 commerce detail remains separate despite space

reflow: party dock may use wider text but same four-column structure
collapse: nothing required for size; content priority still limits P2
viewportContracts.antiBloat: header, chips, buttons, bottom nav remain reference token size; no proportional enlargement

battlefieldRules.anchor: ground lineとcombatant foot anchorsを固定し、top cropの増減でheightへ対応

horizontalComposition.compact: cats occupy x=0.08..0.53, enemy x=0.68..0.94; attack corridor至少15% width
horizontalComposition.expanded: cats x=0.08..0.54, enemy x=0.72..0.93; extra width becomes spacing

battlefieldRules.verticalComposition: frontline foot y=0.80..0.86、backline foot y=0.72..0.78。enemy foot y=0.80..0.86。
battlefieldRules.catMinimum: visible bounds height 54px以上、顔幅18px以上をbrowser evidenceで測定
battlefieldRules.enemyMinimum: visible bounds height 68px以上。通常敵はcatの1.2から1.5倍、S08 boss scaleへしない。
battlefieldRules.overlap: 各catの顔と主装備の65%以上、enemy silhouetteの75%以上を維持
battlefieldRules.effects: damage textとimpactがenemy HP、floor、party labelsを隠さない
battlefieldRules.backgroundCrop: 320幅は左右の補助物をcropし、doorway、ground path、light directionは残す。430幅はhidden extentを見せる。

headerRules.compact: floor、objective、AUTO、run coin only if bound。secondary resource hidden。
headerRules.standard: floor + objective、AUTO、one or two real resource chips
headerRules.expanded: 余白を増やしてもheader高さは最大92px。P3情報を追加しない。
headerRules.dynamicIsland: center top 126px幅を必須tap targetで占有しない。左右またはsafe inset下へ置く。

partyDockRules.layout: four equal columns; no horizontal carousel for the persistent four slots
partyDockRules.labels: 戦場参加中、所有済み、加入可能、未解放を11px以上で表示。shape/edge/iconを併用。
partyDockRules.overflow: name ellipsis may occur only after state label remains intact; accessible full name retained

bottomNavigationRules.homeIndicator: target content ends above bottom safe inset
bottomNavigationRules.sticky: position sticky at document bottom preferred; fixed only with content padding equal to total bar height

modalRules.compact: bottom sheet width100%, rounded top corners only, safe bottom action padding
modalRules.standard: center sheet with 16px side margin unless content/keyboard forces bottom sheet
modalRules.scroll: title and actions fixed within sheet; body only scrolls
modalRules.actions: minimum48px, one primary, optional secondary separated8px
modalRules.offlineReconciliation: state label、elapsed、provisional/confirmed rows、retry statusをclipしない
modalRules.largeText: action labels wrap to two lines; no horizontal button squeeze below44px

largeText.testScale: browser 200% text or equivalent OS accessibility setting

orientationAndUnsupported.landscape: P1 Golden Master対象外。将来実装ではrotation guidanceまたはsafe reflowを定義するまでproduction-readyとしない。
orientationAndUnsupported.below320Width: not a P1 supported viewport; preserve zoom and expose horizontal-safe fallback rather than silent scaling

reviewPageModes.fitWidth: outer review chrome only scales preview to container; dimensions label and effective scale are visible
reviewPageModes.oneToOne: Golden Master viewport is rendered at1 CSS px per design px with page scroll
reviewPageModes.isolated: one GM only, no collage dependency
reviewPageModes.referenceComparison: reference and GM are separate panels with explicit labels; reference is not runtime input
reviewPageModes.largeText: same GM state rendered with text-only scale

requiredMeasurementsPerViewport: battlefield visible bounding box and intersection with viewport
each cat visible bounds and minimum height
enemy visible bounds and minimum height
bottom nav position and safe-bottom pad
fail: battlefield top or bottom outside expected initial view because of automatic scroll
critical text below12px or supporting text below11px
bottom nav intersects home indicator safe area
430 variant bloats UI instead of expanding battlefield
